queries.description: test selecting integer values
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM {ints}

queries.comment: we don't properly support overflow behavior because we return doubles
queries.description: overflow behavior
queries.sql: SELECT int32 + 1, int32 - 1, int64 + 1, int64 -1 FROM {ints}

numeric.comment: ANSI SQL calls this type NUMERIC(precision, scale) but we call it BIG_DECIMAL

queries.description: test support for numeric types of arbitrary precision and scale with values larger than long can support
queries.sql: SELECT big FROM {numeric}

nan_infinity.comment: we don't support NaN or Infinity

queries.TODO: for some reason, when we select * with this test the timestamp column gets returned as well...
queries.sql: SELECT big, floatv, doublev FROM {numeric}

queries.description: test floating point precision
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM {floats}

queries.description: test floating point overflow
queries.sql: SELECT floatv + 1, doublev + 1 FROM {floats}

exact_literals_beyond_int_and_long.comment: Calcite gives an integer literal beyond the BIGINT range, and CAST(... AS DECIMAL(p, 0)), the type DECIMAL(p, 0). 7766279631452241919 is 99999999999999999999 wrapped around to a LONG, and -1294967296 is 3000000000 wrapped around to an INT.

queries.description: equality with a literal beyond the BIGINT range in the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} WHERE longCol = 99999999999999999999

queries.description: range filter with a literal beyond the BIGINT range in the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} WHERE longCol < 9223372036854775808

queries.description: IN filter with a literal beyond the BIGINT range in the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} WHERE longCol IN (1, 99999999999999999999)

queries.description: range filter with a negative literal beyond the BIGINT range in the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} WHERE longCol > -9223372036854775809

queries.description: arithmetic with a literal beyond the BIGINT range in the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT intCol + 99999999999999999999 FROM {tbl}

queries.description: comparison with a literal beyond the BIGINT range in an intermediate stage
queries.sql: SELECT longCol, longCol < 9223372036854775808, longCol = 99999999999999999999 FROM (SELECT longCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY longCol)

queries.description: arithmetic with a literal beyond the BIGINT range in an intermediate stage
queries.sql: SELECT intCol + 99999999999999999999 FROM (SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY intCol)

queries.description: arithmetic with a literal beyond the BIGINT range that is evaluated during planning
BIGINT value promoted to DECIMAL(19, 0) keeps its exact value
queries.sql: SELECT intCol, COALESCE(longCol, CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(5, 0))) FROM {tbl}

queries.description: BIGINT value promoted to DECIMAL(19, 0) in an intermediate stage keeps its exact value
queries.sql: SELECT longCol, COALESCE(longCol, CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(5, 0))) FROM (SELECT longCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY longCol)

queries.description: group by a value that can be a literal beyond the BIGINT range
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN intCol > 0 THEN longCol ELSE 99999999999999999999 END AS v, COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY CASE WHEN intCol > 0 THEN longCol ELSE 99999999999999999999 END

queries.description: equality with a DECIMAL(10, 0) literal beyond the INT range in the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT longCol FROM {tbl} WHERE intCol = CAST(3000000000 AS DECIMAL(10, 0))

queries.description: range filter with a DECIMAL(10, 0) literal beyond the INT range in the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT longCol FROM {tbl} WHERE intCol < CAST(3000000000 AS DECIMAL(10, 0))

queries.description: comparison with a DECIMAL(10, 0) literal beyond the INT range in an intermediate stage
queries.sql: SELECT intCol, intCol < CAST(3000000000 AS DECIMAL(10, 0)), intCol = CAST(3000000000 AS DECIMAL(10, 0)) FROM (SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY intCol)

queries.description: aggregations of DECIMAL(p, 0) values beyond the INT range
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(intCol AS DECIMAL(10, 0))), SUM(CAST(intCol AS DECIMAL(20, 0))), MAX(CAST(intCol AS DECIMAL(20, 0))) FROM {tbl} WHERE intCol > 0

queries.description: group by aggregation of DECIMAL(10, 0) values beyond the INT range
queries.sql: SELECT intCol > 0, SUM(CAST(intCol AS DECIMAL(10, 0))) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY intCol > 0
